title: Capability Event
description: The standard unit of input to the Event Collector (#4). Every action, transfer, tool invocation, or permission change in the multi-agent system is reported as one Event. The Event Collector normalises these into edges/nodes on the Dynamic Capability Graph (#6).

event_id.description: Globally unique identifier for this event, e.g. 'evt-000042'.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of when the action occurred.

trajectory_id.description: Identifies the simulator run this event belongs to (#1, #35). Lets the evaluation harness group events into one benign or attack scenario.

agent_id.description: The agent performing the action, e.g. 'file_agent', 'analysis_agent', 'email_agent'. The subject of the edge.

action.description: The edge type being created/removed on the capability graph. read=agent reads a resource. write=agent modifies a resource. call=agent invokes a tool/API. delegate=agent hands off a task or data to another agent. send=agent transmits data to a destination (agent, tool, or external endpoint). grant_permission/revoke_permission=the agent's permission set changes.

object.description: What the action was performed on: a resource, tool, or permission.

classification.description: Data sensitivity label at the time of this action (#5, Context Classifier). Required when object.type is 'resource'.

destination.description: Where the object flows to, if this action moves or exposes it. Null for pure reads with no onward transfer.

is_external.description: True if this destination is outside the trusted system boundary (#5). Drives 'prohibited sink' policy checks.

permission_id.description: The permission that authorised this action. Required for the detector/optimiser to know which permission to revoke when computing a minimum cut. Null only for grant_permission events describing a brand-new permission (see permission_id in metadata.granted_permission_id instead).

goal_id.description: The task/goal the agent claims this action serves (#7, goal-aligned label). Used later for goal-mismatch risk scoring; optional in early phases.

result.description: Outcome of the action. 'denied' means enforcement already blocked it (e.g. this event is itself the record of a blocked attempt).

ground_truth_label.description: Evaluation-only annotation set by the simulator/scenario generator (#35). MUST NOT be read by the Compositional Risk Detector (#9) or Policy Engine (#8) -- it exists solely for computing precision/recall/false-positive metrics (#39) after the fact.

metadata.description: Free-form extra context (e.g. granted_permission_id, tool call arguments). Does not affect schema validation of required fields.
